name: Beauty Pageant Judging System
description:
Judging system for beauty pageants.

- Room-based authentication
- Real-time short polling for live results (SWR)
- Persistent score drafts (saved in localStorage and synced to the database)
- Judge status monitoring & management panel

Live in production, e.g. Miss World Thailand 2026, Mister International 2026, Miss/Mister Global 2026.
